name: autonomous-coder-loop
title: Autonomous Coder Loop
description: Sustained autonomous coding: decompose into tiny verified steps, build+test gate every cycle, revert on regression, stop on quota or goal.

steps.instruction: Decompose the goal into a queue of small tasks; each must be implementable and verifiable in one cycle.
Write the queue to a ledger file so the state survives restarts.
Each cycle: read only the files the task touches, make the minimal change, then run build and tests.
Green: record it and take the next task. Red: revert this cycle's change and retry once with a different approach.
Use cheap models for grunt work; escalate to the smart lane only for architecture decisions.
Track cost per cycle; stop on budget, on repeated failure, or when the queue empties.
No cycle counts as done without the proof gate passing: build green and tests pass.
